en.headline: Police examine powder letter at Tsim Sha Tsui office building
en.dek: Officers closed a stretch of Humphreys Avenue after a security guard reported a letter containing white powder at 3 Humphreys Avenue around 9:28am.
body: Police examined a suspicious letter containing white powder at a Tsim Sha Tsui commercial building on Tuesday morning. HK01 reported that a security guard at 3 Humphreys Avenue, the Sze Choi Commercial Building, called police at 9:28am after a letter with white powder was found in a mailbox on the ground floor.

Officers cordoned off a section of Humphreys Avenue, the building entrances, the pavement and a row of motorcycle parking spaces in front of the block. Police inside the building wore respirators. The Explosive Ordnance Disposal Bureau attended to help identify the powder, HK01 said.

Sing Tao also reported that the letter, addressed to a mailbox used by a unit of the building management office, was found that morning, and that the road was closed to vehicles while disposal officers in protective gear entered the management office.
Neither account said what the powder was, whether anyone had been hurt, or whether anyone had been arrested. Police had not, in those reports, named a suspect or said the cordon had been lifted.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀商廈信箱現白色粉末信 爆炸品處理課到場
zh.dek: 早上9時28分保安員報案，堪富利士道3號時財商業大廈地下信箱有可疑信件，警方封鎖一段道路調查。
body: 星期二早上，尖沙咀一幢商廈發現藏有白色粉末的信件，警方到場調查。香港01報道，上午9時28分，堪富利士道3號時財商業大廈保安員報案，指大廈地下信箱有單位接獲一封可疑信件，內藏白色粉末。
警方封鎖一段堪富利士道，並圍封大廈出入口、行人路及前方一列電單車停車位。大廈內有警員配戴防毒面罩。爆炸品處理課人員到場，協助調查粉末成分。
星島亦報道，信件寄往大廈管理處其中一個單位的信箱，保安員發現後報警。堪富利士道全線封閉，車輛不准進入，部分警員戴防毒面具，爆炸品處理課人員穿上防護裝備進入管理處。
兩宗報道都未交代粉末成分、有否人受傷或被捕。報道亦未引述警方指名涉案人士，或說明封鎖是否已經解除。
